headline: Leclerc arrives late in Brazil after the birth of his daughter
body: Ferrari has confirmed Leclerc will skip Thursday's media day after returning to Monaco to be with his family. His daughter Bianca was born on 3 November.

headline: Rain is forecast for qualifying and the race at Interlagos
body: Saturday carries a 50% chance of rain, most likely after 14:00 local time, and it could be heavy. Sunday is cooler at 13 to 19°C with a 40% chance of heavy rain and thunderstorms. Friday is mostly dry.
